review: The Mythical Man-Month kicks off with the simple truth: "Adding manpower to a late software project makes it later." now known as Brooks' Law. The author uses real examples from the '60s to show how this played out in operating system development. Even though tech has changed a lot since then, the book's lessons still feel incredibly relevant - especially for today's web development world. It's eye-opening how much still applies to managing projects and teams.
